<quote by="Announced by Diego i Del Toro i Erigo, Bearer of an Imperial Wayleave">To commission a liao sinecure in Bastion, to be appointed by the Highguard National Assembly, the Chaplain of the Roads, to be responsible for the protection of souls travelling on the roads of Highguard. This position should have tenure and is revocable by the Highguard National Assembly. Fully funded.</quote>
